entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Saint Mary's Catholic Church is a Catholic church in İzmir, Turkey. It is located in the old Frankish neighborhood of the Konak district. The Church was built in honor of the Virgin Mary and opened in 1698. The church was made by the Franciscans who were settled in Izmir. Today it is used as an Italian Catholic Church with Franciscan priests serving a community of about 200 people.
